svg.aria-label: RevAI Malware Reverse Engineering Architecture Flow

g.text: Deterministic Tool Skeleton · Cognitive LLM Union · 28 Reverse Engineering Tools · 7-Stage Spine
STAGE 1: BINARY INGESTION & SQL DISASSEMBLY
HEADLESS ENGINE
• Ghidra & IDA Pro Headless: Populates structured SQLite DB via `ghidrasql` / `idasql` (no scraping)
• Format Extractors: LIEF, diec, GoReSym, FindCrypt, ilspycmd, RIFT, pycdc for compiler/packer signatures
• Emulation Oracle & Unpack Pass: Speakeasy / scdbg API simulation + anti-analysis detection
• Stores function call graphs, strings, decompiler AST, and section hashes in local session SQLite DB
Normalized SQL & Format Artifacts
STAGE 2: DETERMINISTIC GATHERING (28 TOOLS)
FAIL-OPEN SKELETON
• 28 Deterministic Tools: capa (ATT&CK mapping), Malcat, YARA, FLOSS, radare2, z3, angr, FindCrypt
• revai-tools Native Extensions: Mitigations-with-consequence, sink-site audit, wallet & IOC extraction
• Stage-Tagged Evidence Pack: Emits uncapped JSON (`00-tools-raw.json`) with zero hallucination
• Quick Scan Triage evaluates binary risk score (0-100) before triggering compute-heavy deep dive
Factual Evidence Pack (No RAG)
STAGE 3: AGENTIC REASONING (LANGGRAPH REACT)
COGNITIVE UNION
• LangGraph ReAct Loop: Cognitive LLM executes `Plan ➔ Act ➔ Observe` with 23 agent-callable tools
• Evidence-Pack Grounding: Direct SQL queries on disassembled functions, call trees & cross-refs
• Deobfuscation & Protocol Extraction: Decodes C2 endpoints, crypto keys, and persistence logic
• Bounded agentic recovery loops resolve decompilation gaps without open-ended recursion
Verdict & Behavioral Findings
STAGE 4: VERDICT CALIBRATION & HITL GATE
SAFETY & HITL
• Verdict Calibration Contract: Obfuscation/packers are NEUTRAL; malicious verdicts strictly require intent
• ✋ Human-in-the-Loop Gate: `CADRE_HITL_WAIT=1` pauses critical verdicts for operator `hitl_approve.py`
• Automated Rule Generation: Synthesizes verified YARA-X (`rule.yar`) & capa YAML behavior signatures
• Extends IOC ledger with defanged network endpoints, crypto hashes, and cryptocurrency wallets
Audited Findings & Signatures
STAGE 5: REPORT SYNTHESIS & TRULY_GREEN GATE
DELIVERABLES
• Honest Quality Gate (`report_quality.py`): `truly_green` = `all_green` + 0 stubs + 0 failed tools
• Comprehensive Deliverables: `REPORT-MASTER-v3.md`, `REPORT-TECHNICAL-v3.md`, `iocs.json`, `stage_trace.json`
• Audit Trail & Provenance: Tracks LLM model token usage, tool latency, and fallback states
• Interactive Flask + React Console (`:5000`) for visual triage, disassembly, and case-study publishing
↻ DYNAMIC UNPACK & FUNCTION RECOVERY
